The Schwarz Etienne Roma Synergy by Kari Voutilainen Kaufmann de Suisse (WROVMA24SSCUBCLTD) features a 39mm stainless steel case surrounding a black, purple dial on a black alligator strap with purple stritching and a stainless steel deployant clasp. Functions include hours, minutes and seconds. This watch comes complete with the original box and papers and is a Limited Edition piece of 15! This Schwarz Etienne watch also measures 11.4mm in thickness and 44.8mm from lug-to-lug.
